**Answer**

\(2^{5^5}\) is an astronomically large number.  
It can be written exactly as

\[
2^{5^5}=2^{3125}
\]

which is a **942‑digit integer**.  
In scientific notation it is approximately

\[
2^{3125}\;\approx\;1.0902\times10^{941}.
\]

So the value of “2 的 5 次方 的 次方” (i.e. \(2^{5^5}\)) is the 942‑digit integer \(2^{3125}\), roughly \(1.09\times10^{941}\).
